bear_assumptions: Full-year GAAP EPS reaches only the USD 10.36 low end of guidance and receives a 27.5x multiple as acquisition integration, leverage, working-capital growth and margin normalization outweigh backlog strength.
base_assumptions: Full-year adjusted EPS reaches the USD 13.50 guidance midpoint and receives a 25.9x multiple as electrical backlog converts, but acquisition leverage and the post-results premium persist.
bull_assumptions: Adjusted EPS reaches at least guidance while sustained mid-teens organic growth, resilient margins, visible deleveraging and Mobility separation benefits support an approximately 33x multiple.
rating_change_conditions: Upgrade only if a fresh mark restores required confidence-adjusted expected return, base upside, bear/base and expected/bear payoff, and margin of safety while electrical orders, backlog conversion, margins, cash flow and deleveraging remain supported; downgrade if orders or backlog contract, cancellations rise, margins compress, cash conversion weakens, acquisitions miss returns, leverage constrains capital allocation, or customer concentration and over-ordering impair the causal thesis.
